name: Financial Impact - Transaction Record Manipulation Attempt (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic baseline transaction in the lab bfsisim ledger, then attempts to overwrite it with a tampered amount. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP POST to lab-local ledger (duplicate-id attempt)
detection: Transaction-integrity control: rejection of in-place amount changes

name: Financial Impact - Payment Instruction Manipulation Attempt (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic payment-instruction-shaped transaction (beneficiary account field), then attempts an unauthorized overwrite of that field via the same id. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP POST to lab-local ledger (duplicate-id attempt)
detection: Payment-instruction integrity control: rejection of unauthorized field mutation

name: Financial Impact - ATM Dispense Workflow Manipulation Attempt (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic ATM-dispense-shaped transaction above a synthetic configured limit, then reconciles against a total that excludes it, checking the control flags the mismatch. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP POST + reconcile to lab-local ledger
detection: Reconciliation control: unauthorized dispense request flagged

name: Financial Impact - Fraudulent Transaction Pattern Simulation (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates several small synthetic transactions in rapid succession under one synthetic account (structuring pattern), then checks the account's running total via reconcile. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: Multiple rapid HTTP POSTs to lab-local ledger under one account
detection: Fraud detection: structuring / rapid small-transaction pattern correlation

name: Financial Impact - Transaction Limit Bypass Attempt (Custom)
blast_radius: Posts one synthetic transaction with an amount exceeding a synthetic per-transaction limit, checking whether the test itself correctly detects the over-limit condition on acceptance. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP POST to lab-local ledger exceeding a synthetic limit constant

name: Financial Impact - Financial Reconciliation Manipulation Attempt (Custom)
blast_radius: Creates one synthetic transaction, then calls reconcile with a deliberately wrong expected total, checking that the mismatch is correctly flagged rather than silently accepted. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable.
telemetry: HTTP POST + reconcile with a deliberately incorrect expectedTotal

name: Financial Impact - Recovery and Service Disruption Check (Custom)
blast_radius: Read-only resilience smoke check: confirms the lab ledger stays reachable across a short burst of prior scenarios' writes. Not a disruption attempt against any real system. SKIP when the simulator is unreachable; ERROR (not FAIL) on a timeout.
telemetry: HTTP GET to lab-local ledger before/after a write burst
note: T1499 is approximate: this step checks availability under prior steps' write load, it does not attempt denial of service against any system.
